stages: v3 multiple SPAWN with same army target and income reserve
v4 used-triangle reset added to v3
v5 surround protection added to v4
primary_metric: win/draw/loss, paired by map and seat
secondary_metrics: turn count (not sufficient evidence of strength)
method: original unchanged referee and opponents, serial execution, save every outcome including errors; freeze each source before its series; keep rejected variants
selection: prefer validated wins; when all zero do not claim competitive improvement from survival alone

amendments.reason: v4 reset regresses on completed development series: khoufou clean wins 8 to 1; Lacoz still zero clean wins. Do not compound this regression.
amendments.timing_policy: retain original 1000/50ms limits and every result; report timeout wins separately from clean game wins; secondary metrics on clean games only; no claim of strategy improvement from opponent timeout

validation_protocol.order: interleaved per map/seat/opponent, rotating variant order
validation_protocol.reason: confirm the individual effects on unseen maps; interleaving reduces time-of-run differences in local scheduling
validation_protocol.interpretation: primary strategy evidence: clean wins; report technical outcomes and own timeouts separately. Prefer simpler v3 unless protection shows a reproducible gain.
